email.subject: Quick note on Honey Pros' website
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I looked at Honey Pros Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "hair salon Harbor Falls" have to manually dial instead of tapping to call, and there are no reviews shown, which makes new visitors less likely to trust and book with an unfamiliar salon.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes stuff like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why, no obligation.

Would Thursday or Friday work for a quick call?

Alex
